Partitions.Name: LoadedFactQuery

let
	Base = ReferencedQuery,
	ParameterConsumer = ParameterConsumerQuery,
	Dynamic = DynamicQuery,
	Lineage = LineageTransformQuery,
	AddedLineage = AddColumnLineageQuery,
	GroupedLineage = GroupLineageQuery,
	CombinedLineage = CombineLineageQuery,
	UnpivotedLineage = UnpivotLineageQuery,
	LocalFile = LocalFileQuery,
	NetworkFile = NetworkFileQuery,
	RelativeFile = RelativeFileQuery,
	WebSource = WebSourceQuery,
	NamedServer = NamedServerQuery,
	DynamicSource = DynamicSourceQuery
in
	Base

NamedExpressions.Name: AddColumnLineageQuery
NamedExpressions.Expression:
let
	Added = Table.AddColumn(Fact, "Added", each [LineageAddLeft] & [LineageAddRight])
in
	Added

NamedExpressions.Name: CombineLineageQuery
NamedExpressions.Expression:
let
	Combined = Table.Combine({Fact, Dimension}, {"LineageCombineFact", "LineageCombineDimension"})
in
	Combined

NamedExpressions.Name: GroupLineageQuery
NamedExpressions.Expression:
let
	Grouped = Table.Group(Fact, {"LineageGroupKey"}, {{"Total", each List.Sum([LineageGroupValue]), type number}})
in
	Grouped

NamedExpressions.Name: LineageTransformQuery
NamedExpressions.Expression:
let
	Selected = Table.SelectColumns(Fact, {"LineageSelectedColumn"}),
	Removed = Table.RemoveColumns(Fact, {"LineageRemovedColumn"}),
	Renamed = Table.RenameColumns(Fact, {{"LineageRenamedColumn", "RenamedOutput"}}),
	Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Fact, {{"LineageTransformedColumn", type text}}),
	Joined = Table.NestedJoin(Fact, {"LineageMergeKey"}, Dimension, {"DimensionKey"}, "DimensionRows", JoinKind.LeftOuter),
	Expanded = Table.ExpandTableColumn(Joined, "DimensionRows", {"LineageExpandedColumn"}, {"LineageExpandedColumn"})
in
	Expanded
